title: Larabanga Mosque
axis: +X follows the photographed south elevation roughly eastward. +Z faces the area south of the mosque.
source: OpenStreetMap mosque way 709927303 and named node 7067987939, with the University of Ghana inventory and the Ghana Museums and Monuments Board description.
identityStatus: The named Q490898 place node and mapped mosque agree with the University of Ghana site location. The story coordinate is 842m from the mapped envelope. The four mapped corners are about 11m apart, while the national board gives an approximate 8m by 8m structure.
geometryLabel: Four mapped outer envelope points, the named site point and the mapped adjacent baobab

terrainContact.basis: Public source elevation near the photographed south entrance.

notes: The whitewashed Larabanga Mosque after restoration, around the 2010 Qualla publication. The exterior includes the tapered earthen buttresses, projecting timber torons, tall minaret and mihrab tower, and the small entrance with its patterned panel. The mapped baobab and photographs support an approximate south-facing frontage. Individual buttress spacing, exact section and rear details require interpretation.
